ranked.text: The planning-api Deployment is scaled to zero desired replicas, leaving the planning-api service with no available backends and causing grid-operator plan fetch transport errors.
A recent GitOps commit or rollout touching planning-api set the Deployment desired replicas to zero, producing the outage.
The planning-api Deployment desires at least one replica, but its pods are not ready or available, so the planning-api service has no healthy backends for grid-operator.
The planning-api service has available backends, but the network or service routing path between grid-operator and planning-api is failing, causing transport errors.
